name: Milk Swim
source:
Haruhiko has failed his exams and will repeat the grade, but does not dare to tell his parents. As a thick fog covers the city, he knows there are only three days left before his parents will find out. 

[From [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]Official site[/url]]
